title: CMP-08: what is it?

sections.heading: What is it?
text: CMP-08 is a small GST form. In it, you tell the government how much you **sold** in the last 3 months. Then you **pay the GST** for those 3 months.

sections.heading: Who must fill it?
text: Shops and businesses in the GST **composition scheme**. This is a simple GST plan for small businesses. Your profile in this app says "Composition" if you are in it.

sections.heading: How often?
text: **4 times a year**, once every 3 months. The last day to file is shown on this page and in your calendar.

sections.heading: What if I am late?
points: There is no late fee for CMP-08.
Your yearly form, GSTR-4, is made from your CMP-08 forms. So do not skip it.

sections.heading: Can I do it myself?
text: **Yes, most people can.** You only need your sales for the 3 months.
Ask a CA (tax expert) for help if you are not sure you can still stay in the composition scheme.
